About Austrian Airlines AG

Discover a world full of possibilities. Make your professional dreams come true at Austrian Airlines. We are an open and warmhearted community where internationality and open-mindedness play a major role. Hospitality and service-orientation are our top priorities, we put people - our employees just like our guests first. We are focusing on creating an inspiring working environment where everyone can feel at home. Together we can create unforgettable experiences and memories. Let us #CreateJourneysTogether

We are looking for 1 Senior Technical Purchasers (all genders)  We've got the aircraft, you've got the drive and passion for technology! 

Tasks

 * You are responsible for sourcing spare parts for the repair of aircraft components, including selecting suitable sourcing channels, order tracking, and tracking parts throughout the repair cycle.

 * You provide operational support and expertise to Strategic Procurement in negotiating contracts and are responsible for their operational execution.

 * You manage projects to expand the 3rd party customer portfolio and the capability of the workshops.

 * Together with internal customers and suppliers, you develop solutions to ensure a reliable supply of materials to ensure the timely repair of aircraft parts.

 * You implement measures to prevent material shortages.

 * You analyze demand, inventory levels, supplier performance, and procurement costs, and derive appropriate measures for optimization.

 * You are be responsible for maintaining relevant data in AMOS. 

 

Ready to take off with us?

At Austrian Airlines, the only things that count are your skills, your motivation and what makes you special as a person. Origin, gender or age are irrelevant: together we bring people and cultures together and give our work real meaning. Convinced? Then apply now! 

Requirements

 * You have a solid technical or commercial background (e.g. HTL, HAK or a comparable qualification) or possess relevant practical experience.

 * You have relevant professional experience in procurement, supply chain mgmt, or logistics, and ideally, you are already familiar with similar processes. 

 * You are proficient in standard MS Office applications - practical experience with AMOS is a major advantage for us.

 * You communicate fluently in both German and English (negotiation level).

 * You possess sound knowledge of current aviation regulations that play a role in our daily operations.

 * You impress with your confident demeanor, remain focused even during stressful periods, and value working as part of a team.

 * You have unrestricted access to the Austrian labor market.

* Your actual salary resp.remuneration will be determined individually based on your qualifications and professional experience. Depending on your experience and expertise, a higher salary may be offered. If not all requirements of the position are met, the position and individual grading may be reassessed.

This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology. * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications. * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation. * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range. * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems. * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system. * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.Your qualifications: * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field. * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further. * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications. * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous. * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial. * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).  At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.
